links.outcome: Agreement of ChatGPT-5 with board-certified surgeon consensus on facelift candidacy and aging features
links.effect: Facelift candidacy agreement 95.5% (21/22; κ=0.91; McNemar P=1.00); binary aging features 81.8-90.9% (κ≈0.61-0.81); ordinal severity exact agreement 77.3%, weighted κ 0.74-0.86.
links.quote: For facelift candidacy, agreement was 95.5% (21/22; Cohen's κ = 0.91; McNemar P = 1.00).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic/assessment accuracy of ChatGPT-5 against board-certified plastic surgeons using standardized photographs in an offline pilot study, without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
